description:
List the auto-assignment rules of a property — the patterns that tag keywords/pages automatically (see create_tag_rule). Optionally filter by tag. Each rule returns rule_id, tag, field (keyword|url), country and its conditions (match + value). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// list the auto-assignment rules targeting the Priority Pages tag.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","tag":"Priority Pages"}
```
name: list_tag_rules
title: Auto-tag rules
